response.overview: # Translation  The story follows Firzan (Rosyam Nor), a man who builds his political empire before becoming a figure revered by society. Starting as a personal assistant to an influential politician, Firzan gradually learns that power can change everything. From there, he begins using marriage as a way to open doors in the political world before successfully building his own influence and empire. However, in Firzan's world, power trumps everything, including his own family. The arrival of Diana (Sophia Albarakbah), a famous social media influencer who is also the girlfriend of his son, Aiman (Ady Mohammad), begins to create tension when Firzan starts manipulating circumstances to possess the woman for himself. At the same time, his other son, Aidil (Shahz Jaszle), is still unable to accept Firzan back into his life after harboring hatred towards his father for so long.
